text:
leo: Reprod a dup bug in the onboarding sample when token rotates mid-stream -> upstream 429 -> client retries.

anya: Is this unique to Node?

leo: Node retries and replays the last chunk; Go aborts. SDK parity gap.

ben: Root causes: (1) sampleapp stream helper doesn't attach Idempotency-Key at transport layer; (2) SDK retry jitter differs (deterministic vs crypto) so retries sometimes line up.

tara: Quick plan: add transport-level idempotency header in sampleapp examples, and a lint that fails CI if write calls lack it.

ben: Also spec a small randomized delta for Retry-After: wait = value + rand(0, min(1s, value*0.15)). Breaks lockstep.

leo: SDK change: include x-client-replay-hash (sha256 of last-acked-op) when resuming after auth-related 429. Go to match Node.

anya: Telemetry: emit "unsafe_replay" with sdk and replay_hash (hash only) so we can find regressing examples.

ci-bot: deploy queued: sampleapp/idempotency-transport v1 -> staging at 1979002400 :rocket:

leo: I'll open PRs: sampleapp lint+transport, node SDK header, go SDK parity, and an e2e that simulates rotation+429 asserting single-write semantics. Post links here when ready.
